pages.raw_meta: We are a digitally enabled solutions provider focused on defense, intelligence, and infrastructure. Learn more about life at Parsons today!
raw_blocks: Founded in 1944, Parsons Corporation, a digitally enabled solutions provider, is focused on creating the future of the defense, intelligence, and critical infrastructure markets. From Earth to outer space, we deliver tomorrow’s solutions today. Equipped with the capabilities required to take on any defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure challenge, our agile, innovative, and disruptive approach enables us to deliver solutions at the speed of relevance.

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to be an employer of choice that engages employees in the community and creates rewarding career paths to cultivate a resilient workforce that is ready for the future.

As connectivity increases, geopolitical conditions shift, near-peer threats loom, and technology advances, we stand ready to help confront rapidly evolving security challenges in every domain—land, sea, air, space, and cyber. Learn More

For more than 75 years, our experts have designed and delivered the critical infrastructure that connects and protects communities around the world. Using our technological expertise, we deliver a cleaner and safer planet for our customers and for future generations. Learn More

We maintain a global footprint, operating in more than 30 countries with over 21,000 employees worldwide. Our presence spans from North America, including extensive projects and offices across the United States and Canada, to Europe, the Middle East, and beyond. Learn More

As connectivity increases, geopolitical conditions shift, near-peer threats loom, and technology advances, we stand ready to help confront rapidly evolving security challenges in every domain—land, sea, air, space, and cyber.

For more than 75 years, our experts have designed and delivered the critical infrastructure that connects and protects communities around the world. Using our technological expertise, we deliver a cleaner and safer planet for our customers and for future generations.

We maintain a global footprint, operating in more than 30 countries with over 20,000 employees worldwide. Our presence spans from North America, including extensive projects and offices across the United States and Canada, to Europe, the Middle East, and beyond.

We’re a company of thinkers and innovators. Our people don’t just generate big ideas—they bring them to life. We operate in a variety of services and markets around the globe, which means that, although we’re one company, there are many possibilities for growth and development throughout your career, not to mention opportunities for flexibility, internal mobility, and optimizing your work-life balance.

We set high standards for our people, and we expect that they set high standards for us. The result is a thriving culture and a number of programs and initiatives we all can be proud of.

At Parsons, we are dedicated to supporting our interns as they imagine what’s next for themselves and elevate their careers. Through our Internship Program, students can obtain real-world experience while making valuable impact on our teams through the work that they do.

Through our employee-driven program, we serve the communities in which we live, work, and play. Through charitable contributions and volunteerism our employees assist improving quality of life while making the world a better place daily.

Employees are our number one asset, which is why we created our Parsons Distinguished Recognition and Incentive (DRIVE) Program to recognize and reward employees who go above and beyond in their work and their projects, their clients, and their team.

Transitioning from the military can be difficult, which is why at Parsons you will find a community of support, camaraderie, and appreciation. Our goal is to make all transitions as smooth as possible through our specifically tailored MILVET program.
Regardless Of Your View, You're Always Parsons

Flexible work options (FWOs), including remote working on a permanent or hybrid basis, help us drive productivity, expand our talent pools, and improve sustainability. They enable us to deliver on our mission and vision in new ways. We formally made FWOs our standard operating procedure in the United States and Canada and support flexibility where the nature of work, customer requirements, and corporate regulations and compliance allow for such considerations.
